| EVAL pod_key = CONCAT(namespace, "/", pod)
| STATS cpu_used = SUM(cpu_util * cpu_alloc), cpu_alloc = SUM(cpu_alloc),
        mem_used = SUM(mem_util * mem_alloc), mem_alloc = SUM(mem_alloc),

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type IN ("k8s_container", "k8s_pod", "prometheus_target")
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS cpu = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)),
        restarts = SUM(INCREASE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/restart_count`)),
        mem = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/used_bytes`)),
        cpu_lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/limit_cores`)),
        mem_lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/limit_bytes`)),
        pvc_util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/pod/volume/utilization`)),
        pod_seen = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/pod/network/received_bytes_count`)),
        phase_on = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_pod_status_phase/gauge`)),
        dep = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_spec_replicas/gauge`))
    BY cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.cluster), resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.project_id,
       namespace = COALESCE(resource.attributes.namespace_name, resource.attributes.namespace),
       pod = COALESCE(resource.attributes.pod_name, attributes.pod), resource.attributes.container_name,
       attributes.phase, attributes.persistentvolumeclaim_name, attributes.deployment
| STATS Restarts = ROUND(SUM(restarts)),
        `CPU in use` = SUM(cpu),
        mem_used = SUM(mem),
        cpu_lim_used = SUM(CASE(cpu_lim > 0, cpu, NULL)), cpu_lim = SUM(CASE(cpu_lim > 0, cpu_lim, NULL)),
        mem_lim_used = SUM(CASE(mem_lim > 0, mem, NULL)), mem_lim = SUM(CASE(mem_lim > 0, mem_lim, NULL)),
        `Fullest PVC %` = 100 * MAX(CASE(attributes.persistentvolumeclaim_name IS NOT NULL, pvc_util, NULL)),
        pods_ksm = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(phase_on == 1, pod, NULL)),
        problem_pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(phase_on == 1 AND attributes.phase IN ("Pending", "Failed", "Unknown"), pod, NULL)),
        `Pods reporting usage` = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(pod_seen IS NOT NULL, pod, NULL)),
        deployments = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(dep IS NOT NULL, attributes.deployment, NULL)),
        ksm = COUNT(phase_on)
    BY Namespace = namespace, Cluster = cluster, Location = resource.attributes.location, Project = resource.attributes.project_id
| EVAL `Memory in use` = mem_used / 1073741824.0,
       `CPU limit %` = 100 * cpu_lim_used / cpu_lim,
       `Memory limit %` = TO_DOUBLE(mem_lim_used) / mem_lim,
       `Problem pods` = CASE(ksm > 0, problem_pods, NULL),
       Pods = CASE(ksm > 0, pods_ksm, NULL),
       Deployments = CASE(ksm > 0, deployments, NULL)
| KEEP Namespace, Cluster, Location, Project, Restarts, `Problem pods`, Pods, `Pods reporting usage`, Deployments, `CPU in use`, `CPU limit %`, `Memory in use`, `Memory limit %`, `Fullest PVC %`
| SORT Restarts DESC NULLS LAST, `Memory limit %` DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 100

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type IN ("k8s_container", "k8s_pod", "prometheus_target")
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS cpu = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)),

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type IN ("k8s_container", "prometheus_target")
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS mem_util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/limit_utilization`)),
        cpu_used = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)),
        mem_used = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/used_bytes`)),
        restarts = SUM(INCREASE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/restart_count`)),
        eph_used = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`)),
        eph_limit = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/limit_bytes`)),
        cpu_util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/limit_utilization`)),
        phase_on = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_pod_status_phase/gauge`))
    BY pod = COALESCE(resource.attributes.pod_name, attributes.pod),
       namespace = COALESCE(resource.attributes.namespace_name, resource.attributes.namespace),
       cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.cluster),
       resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.project_id,
       resource.attributes.container_name, attributes.phase
| STATS memory_limit_util = MAX(mem_util),
        cpu_used_cores = SUM(cpu_used),
        memory_used_bytes = SUM(mem_used),
        restarts = SUM(restarts),
        ephemeral_used_bytes = SUM(eph_used),
        ephemeral_limit_bytes = SUM(CASE(eph_limit > 0, eph_limit, NULL)),
        cpu_limit_util = MAX(cpu_util),
        phase = MAX(CASE(phase_on == 1, attributes.phase, NULL))
    BY pod, namespace, cluster, location = resource.attributes.location, project = resource.attributes.project_id
| EVAL restarts = ROUND(restarts), memory_used_gib = memory_used_bytes / 1073741824.0, ephemeral_used_gib = ephemeral_used_bytes / 1073741824.0, ephemeral_limit = COALESCE(CONCAT(TO_STRING(ROUND(ephemeral_limit_bytes / 1073741824.0, 2)), " GiB"), "No limit"), cpu_limit_pct = 100 * cpu_limit_util
| SORT memory_limit_util DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 100
| KEEP pod, namespace, cluster, location, project, memory_limit_util, phase, restarts, cpu_limit_pct, cpu_used_cores, memory_used_gib, ephemeral_used_gib, ephemeral_limit
